source.name: short head of right biceps brachii

segmentation.limits: Largest source-plane loop, consistent non-convex perimeter triangulation and authored 25% peak-area belly cut. Straight reference edges and curved centreline guides. Not measured tendon/aponeurosis boundaries or fibre architecture.

reference_repair.method: Local transverse ring-plane translations from least-norm signed-distance corrections; adaptive transverse-intersection samples; straight P2 edges rebuilt. Every prism-tetrahedron determinant remains positive.
reference_repair.intended_entheses: Source bone patch anchor samples remain on the cortex; muscle-belly volume is repaired outside bones. No negative tissue volume is relabelled as an enthesis.

supports.limits: Original head fan and weak-matrix laws; external targets, route guides, common sheet and joint frozen at reference. No bone contact.

limits: Full nodal forces are a separate diagnostic: passing projected force balance does not pass full nodal stationarity.

Virtual displacement is dimensionless phi=(1-s)*reference axis, so derivative with respect to a metre of virtual displacement is a force in N. It equals the axis on the distal cap and zero on the proximal cap.
Direct body/sheet cap forces, external support forces, and whole-body virtual work are reported separately; virtual-minus-direct contains unbalanced free-node work at a restricted equilibrium.
Active Cauchy scalar is a*sigma0*fL*lambda/J along the current local fiber; it is not the peak first-Piola parameter.
Full nodal forces are a separate diagnostic: passing projected force balance does not pass full nodal stationarity.

Virtual displacement is dimensionless phi=(1-s)*reference axis, so derivative with respect to a metre of virtual displacement is a force in N. It equals the axis on the distal cap and zero on the proximal cap.
Direct body/sheet cap forces, external support forces, and whole-body virtual work are reported separately; virtual-minus-direct contains unbalanced free-node work at a restricted equilibrium.
Active Cauchy scalar is a*sigma0*fL*lambda/J along the current local fiber; it is not the peak first-Piola parameter.
This is an isolated reduced diagnostic fixture, not an accepted full nodal or coupled-arm equilibrium. Full free-nodal forces are reported separately.
The named head retains exact current coefficients, constitutive potentials, force-length window and Newton implementation. No force target is fitted.
Both geometry controls have the same volume, length, P2 connectivity, seven transverse-affine ring planes, axial fibers and ideal fixed caps; sheets and contact are absent.
Attachment controls freeze the authored head support targets, routing guides, shared sheet and joint at reference; they do not reproduce the moving coupled apparatus.
Only accepted reduced force/geometry states advance activation within this isolated continuation. Failure ends the predeclared schedule and retains the old accepted state.
No bone or neighboring-muscle contact, skin, constitutive edits or publication changes.
